destinationBlurbs.issyk_kul: The world's second-largest alpine lake: beaches, resorts and hot springs.
destinationBlurbs.karakol: Base for treks to Ala-Kul and Altyn-Arashan, and a ski resort in winter.
destinationBlurbs.song_kol: High-altitude lake with yurt camps, nomadic life and horse rides.
destinationBlurbs.ala_archa: National park 40 minutes from Bishkek — perfect for a day hike.
destinationBlurbs.bishkek: The capital: bazaars, museums and the starting point of most trips.
destinationBlurbs.osh: Ancient southern city, Sulaiman-Too mountain and the country's liveliest bazaar.
